name: Narrator's mother
description: The narrator's mother, who married Vinack out of necessity but came to love him, and who died when the narrator was seventeen.

timeline.summary: The narrator's mother marries Vinack when the narrator is ten, after the narrator was beaten by farmhands' sons.
timeline.quote: When I was ten when my mother married him and, at the time, I didn't hate him.

timeline.summary: The narrator confronts Vinack after seeing his mother's bruised face, and Vinack strikes him.
timeline.quote: He told me to know my place and struck me in the head.

timeline.summary: The narrator tells Vinack he is a selfish beast, and Vinack beats him until the mother and farmhands throw him out.
The narrator's mother dies of failing health when he is seventeen, leaving him in charge of the farmland.
timeline.quote: My mother passed away when I was seventeen and I was then in charge of our farmland.

relations.note: He married her, becoming the narrator's stepfather.
relations.quote: I hate the man who married my mother.
